40019204.author: पदार्थः
40019204.content: महाप्राज्ञः highly learned, सःप्लवङ्गमः that monkey, वचनमर्थज्ञो meaningful, सर्वधनुष्मताम् foremost among the wielders of bow, वरम् choicest, तंरामम् Rama, अभिवाद्य greeted, उवाच spoke

40019204.author: Translation
40019204.content: Highly learned Hanuman greeted and spoke meaningfully to Rama, the foremost among the wielders of bow.

40019205.author: पदार्थः
40019205.content: कर्मणाम् these actions, अयम् this, आरम्बः started, यन्निमित्तः for whose sake, यः he who, फलोदयः has borne fruit, ताम् her, शोकसन्तप्ताम् immersed in grief, देवीम् noble lady, मैथिलीम् Mythili, द्रष्टुम् to see, अर्हसि ought to

40019205.author: Translation
40019205.content: "You ought to see that noble lady Mythili, who was immersed in grief, for whose sake these actions were started and has borne fruit."

40019206.author: पदार्थः
40019206.content: शोकसमाविष्टाः who is overcome with grief, सामैथिली she, Mythili, विजयम् victory, श्रुत्वा hearing, बाष्पपर्याकुलेक्षणा eyes filled with tears, त्वाम् you, द्रष्टुम् to see, अभिकाङ्क्षति desired

40019206.author: Translation
40019206.content: "Mythili who is overcome with grief on hearing your victory, was filled with tears in her eyes and desired to see you."

40019207.author: पदार्थः
40019207.content: पूर्वकात् earlier occasion, प्रत्ययात् expressed, विश्वस्तया trust, तया so also, अहम् I, उक्तः said, कृतार्थम् gratitude, सहलक्ष्मणम् with Lakshmana, भर्तारम् husband, द्रष्टुम् to see, इच्छामि desire

40019207.author: Translation
40019207.content: "In an earlier occasion having known me and trusting me expressed that she desires to see Rama with Lakshmana after victory and with gratitude."

40019208.author: पदार्थः
40019208.content: हनुमता Hanuman, एवम् in that way, उक्तः having spoken, धर्मभृताम् upholder of righteousness, वरः best, रामः Rama, ईषत् slightly, बाष्पपरिप्लुतः shed tears from eyes, सहसा suddenly, ध्यानम् thoughtful, आगच्छत् became

40019208.author: Translation
40019208.content: When Hanuman had spoken like that, Rama, the upholder of righteousness, shed tears slightly and suddenly became thoughtful.

40019209.author: पदार्थः
40019209.content: दीर्घम् long, उष्णम् hot, विनिःश्वस्य drawing breath, जगतीम् on the world, अवलोकयन् looking at, उपस्थितम् standing, मेघसङ्काशम् resembling a cloud in colour, विभीषणम् Vibheeshana, उवाच spoke

40019209.author: Translation
40019209.content: Drawing a long hot breath, looking at the ground, he spoke to Vibheeshana, who was like a cloud standing there.

40019210.author: पदार्थः
40019210.content: शिरःस्नाताम् after head bath, दिव्याङ्गरागाम् anointed with fragrance, दिव्यायभरणभूषिताम् decorated with wonderful ornaments, सीताम् Sita, इह here, उपस्थापय bring, चिरम् quickly, मा bring

40019210.author: Translation
40019210.content: Bring Sita here without delay, bathed, anointed with celestial fragrance and adorned with wonderful ornaments.

40019211.author: पदार्थः
40019211.content: एवम् in that manner, रामेण by Rama, उक्तः spoken, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, त्वरमाणः hastened, अन्तःपुरम् to the gynaeceum, प्रविश्य entered, स्वाभिः for his part, स्त्रीभिः women, सीताम् to Sita, अचोदयात् conveyed

40019211.author: Translation
40019211.content: When Rama had spoken in that manner, Vibheeeshana for his part hastened to the Gynaeceum and assigned through the women to convey to Sita.

40019212.author: पदार्थः
40019212.content: ततः then, श्रीमान् prosperous, राक्षसेश्वरःLord of Rakshasas, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, महाभागाम् the noble, सीताम् to Sita, दृष्टवा seeing, विनीतः his head, मूर्ध्निः head, बद्धाञ्जलिः with palms joined, उवाच spoke

40019212.author: Translation
40019212.content: Then Vibheeshana, the prosperous Lord of the Rakshasas seeing Sita greeted her with palms joined together lifted it over his head (as a sign of respect).

40019213.author: पदार्थः
40019213.content: वैदेही Vaidehi, दिव्याङ्गरागा anointed with wonderful fragrance, दिव्याभरणभूषिता decked with beautiful ornaments, यानम् palanquin, आरोह ascending, ते you, भद्रम् auspicious, भर्ता husband, त्वाम् you, द्रष्टुम् to see, इच्छति desires

40019213.author: Translation
40019213.content: "Vaidehi! Anointed with a wonderful fragrance, decked with beautiful ornaments, auspicious and ascending the palanquin, your husband desires to see you."

40019214.author: पदार्थः
40019214.content: एवम् in that way, उक्ता spoken, वैदेही Vaidehi, विभीषणम् to Vibheeshana, प्रत्युवाच replied, राक्षसेश्वर Lord of Rakshasas, अस्नात्वा without bath, भर्तारम् husband, द्रष्टुम् see, इच्छामि I desire

40019214.author: Translation
40019214.content: Vibheeshana, having spoken that way, Vaidehi said to the Lord of Rakshasas that she would like to see him without having a bath.

40019215.author: पदार्थः
40019215.content: तस्याः her, तत् that, वचनम् words, श्रुत्वा hearing, विभीषणःVibheeshana, प्रत्युवाच replied in turn, ते you, भर्ता  husband, रामःRam, यथा so, आह I, तत् that, तथआ that only, कर्तुम् will do, अर्हसि ought to

40019215.author: Translation
40019215.content: Hearing Sita's words Vibheeshana replied saying," You will and ought to do what your husband Rama has said."

40019216.author: पदार्थः
40019216.content: पतिदेवता husband as god, साध्वी noble, मैथिली Mythili, तस्य her, तत् that, वचनम् words, श्रुत्वा hearing, भर्तृभक्त्या in devotion, वृता adorned, तथेति alright, प्रत्यभाषत replied in turn

40019216.author: Translation
40019216.content: Noble Mythili (on hearing Vibheeshana), who looked upon her husband as God, said in reply, 'Alright'.

40019217.author: पदार्थः
40019217.content: ततः thereafter, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, शिरःस्नाताम् head bath, प्रतिकर्मणा personal decoration, संयुक्ताम् together, महार्हाभरणोपेताम् best of ornaments, महार्हाम्बरधारिणीम् wonderful clothes, सीताम् Sita, दीप्ताम् glowing, परार्घ्याम्बरसंवृताम् covered with wonderful clothes, बहुभिः numerous, राक्षसैः Rakshasas, गुप्ताम् guarded by, शिबिकाम् palanquin, आरोप्य ascended, आजहार brought

40019217.author: Translation
40019217.content: Thereafter Vibheeshana, making Sita to ascend the palanquin, covered with valuable clothes and guarded by numerous Rakshasas after she adorned herself in the best of ornaments and put on glowing wonderful clothes brought to Rama.

40019218.author: पदार्थः
40019218.content: ततः thereafter, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, शिरःस्नाताम् head bath, प्रतिकर्मणा personal decoration, संयुक्ताम् together, महार्हाभरणोपेताम् best of ornaments, महार्हाम्बरधारिणीम् wonderful clothes, सीताम् Sita, दीप्ताम् glowing, परार्घ्याम्बरसंवृताम् covered with wonderful clothes, बहुभिः numerous, राक्षसैः Rakshasas, गुप्ताम् guarded by, शिबिकाम् palanquin, आरोप्य ascended, आजहार brought

40019218.author: Translation
40019218.content: Thereafter Vibheeshana, making Sita to ascend the palanquin, covered with valuable clothes and guarded by numerous Rakshasas after she adorned herself in the best of ornaments and put on glowing wonderful clothes brought to Rama.

40019219.author: पदार्थः
40019219.content: सः he, ज्ञात्वापि after knowing, द्यानम् meditative mood, आस्थितम् absorbed in thought, महात्मानम् great, अभिगम्य having reached, प्रणतः च greeting with folded palms, प्रहृष्टश्च full of joy, सीताम् Sita, प्राप्ताम् arrived, न्यवेदयत् announced

40019219.author: Translation
40019219.content: Knowing that Sita reached also, great Rama was seen in a meditative mood absorbed in thought. Vibheeshana announced saying, 'Sita has been brought' and greeted with folded palms, full of joy.

40019220.author: पदार्थः
40019220.content: रक्षोगृहचिरोषिताम् stayed in Rakshasa's abode for long, ताम् her, आगताम् reached, उपश्रुत्य having heard, राघवम् Raghava, हर्षः joyful, दैन्यम् indignation, रोषश्च anger, त्रयम् three, आविशत् experienced

40019220.author: Translation
40019220.content: On hearing that Sita had arrived, who stayed in Rakshasa's abode for long, Raghava had experienced joy, indignation, and anger, all the three at the same time.

40019221.author: पदार्थः
40019221.content: ततः then, राघवःRaghava, अहृष्टःdistressed, सविमर्शम् analysing with in, विचारयन् thinking, पार्श्वगतम् who had come near, विभीषणम् Vibheeshana, दृष्टवाseeing, इदम् these, वचःwords, अब्रवीत् spoke

40019221.author: Translation
40019221.content: Raghava, analysed with in him, distressed and thinking deeply, seeing Vibheeshana close by, spoke these words.

40019222.author: पदार्थः
40019222.content: नित्यम् always, मद्विजये my victory, रत sought, सौम्य gentle, राक्षसाधिपते Rakshasa king, वैदेहीVaidehi, शीघ्रम् quickly, मे my, सन्निकर्षम् near, समुपगच्छतु let her be brought

40019222.author: Translation
40019222.content: "O gentle Vibheeshana, let Sita who sought my victory always be quickly brought near me."

40019223.author: पदार्थः
40019223.content: तस्यराघवस्य Raghava's, तत् that, वचनम् words, श्रुत्वा on hearing, धर्मवित् faithful, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, तत्र there, तूर्णम् instantly, उत्सारणम् to disperse the people, कारयामास assigned

40019223.author: Translation
40019223.content: On hearing Raghava's words, faithful Vibheeshana instantly assigned people to disperse from there.

40019224.author: पदार्थः
40019224.content: तत्र then, कञ्चुकोष्णीषिणःwearing coats and turbans, वेत्ररर्जरपाणयःholding staffs in hand, तान् them, योधान् warriors, उत्सारयन्तः dispersed, समन्तात् all of them moved, परिचक्रमुःstarted

40019224.author: Translation
40019224.content: Then those who were wearing coats and turbans, holding staffs in hand, warriors started moving and dispersed.

40019225.author: पदार्थः
40019225.content: ऋक्षाणाम् Bears, वानराणां च Vanaras, राक्षसानां च and Rakshasas, सर्वशःall over, उत्सार्यमाणानि moving about, वृन्दानि hordes, अन्ततः vicinity, दूरम् distance, उत्तस्थुः driven

40019225.author: Translation
40019225.content: The hordes of Bears, Vanaras and Rakshasas moving about all over there were driven away to a distance from the vicinity.

40019226.author: पदार्थः
40019226.content: तेषाम् their, उत्सार्यमाणानाम् being driven, वायुना wind, उद्धूयमानस्य sound generated सागरस्य ocean, निःस्वनःइव like the storm, सुमहान् great, स्वनः sound, अभूत् heard

40019226.author: Translation
40019226.content: The great sound heard there was like the uproar of an ocean lashed by a storm.

40019227.author: पदार्थः
40019227.content: अथ now, राघवः Raghava, उत्सार्यमाणान् dispersing, जगत्याम् moving, जातसम्भ्रमान् excited to know, दृष्टवा seeing, दाक्षिण्यात् out of kindness, अमर्षात् resented, तत् that, वारयामास stopped

40019227.author: Translation
40019227.content: Seeing them excited to know and dispersing, Raghava stopped them out of kindness.

40019228.author: पदार्थः
40019228.content: रामः Rama, सम्रब्ध: च uproar, चक्षुषा with his gaze, प्रदहन्निव exhibiting anger, महाप्राज्ञम् highly intelligent, विभीषणम् Vibheeshana, सोपालम्भम् resenting, इदंवचः these words, अब्रवीत् spoke

40019228.author: Translation
40019228.content: Exhibiting anger with his gaze at the uproar, Rama addressed the highly intelligent Vibheeshana resenting their action.

40019229.author: पदार्थः
40019229.content: माम् me, अनादृत्य without regard, त्वया you, अयंजनः these people, किमर्थम् for what reason, क्लिश्यते troubling, उद्योगम् this excitement, निवर्तय stop, अयम् this, जनःpeople, मम my, स्वजनःown

40019229.author: Translation
40019229.content: "Why are these people being troubled without disregard for me? Stop this excitement. They are my own people."

40019230.author: पदार्थः
40019230.content: स्त्रियाः for women, गृहाणि houses, आवरणम् boundary wall, न not, वस्त्राणि clothes, न not, प्राकाराः protective wall, न not, तिरस्क्रिया screen of cloth, न not, ईदृशाः this kind of, राजसत्काराः royal treatment, न not, वृत्तम् surrounded

40019230.author: Translation
40019230.content: "For women it is not the house, boundary wall or clothes or protective wall or screen of cloth or even this kind of royal treatment or surrounding, is the protection."

40019231.author: पदार्थः
40019231.content: व्यसनेषु in times of difficulty, स्त्रियाः woman, दर्शनम् appearance, न दूष्यते not condemned, कृच्छ्रेषु in straits, युद्धेषु in conflicts, स्वयंवरे in selection of spouse, न not, क्रतौ sacrificial ceremony, न not, विवाहे वा marriage, न not

40019231.author: Translation
40019231.content: "The appearance of a woman in public is not condemned in times of difficulty, in straits, in conflicts, in the selection of a husband, or in sacrificial ceremonies or marriage ceremonies."

40019232.author: पदार्थः
40019232.content: साएषा she now, विपद्गताचैव in distress, महति great, कृच्छ्रे miserable, स्थिता situation, अस्याः her, दर्शने appearance, दोषः fault, नास्ति not, विशेषतः especially, मत्समीपे my presence

40019232.author: Translation
40019232.content: "Sita is in distress and in a highly miserable situation. Her appearance is no fault especially in my presence."

40019233.author: पदार्थः
40019233.content: तस्मात् therefore, शिबिकाम् palanquin, विसृज्य leaving, पद्भ्यामेव on foot only, उपसर्पतु advance towards, एते with the help of these, वनौकसः Vanaras, मम my, समीपे presence, वैदेहीम् Vaidehi, पश्यन्तु to see

40019233.author: Translation
40019233.content: "Therefore, leaving the palanquin let Vaidehi walk on foot only towards me with the help of these Vanaras."

40019234.author: पदार्थः
40019234.content: रामेण by Rama, एवम् in that way, उक्तःhaving spoken, सविमर्शःclearly, विभीषणम् Vibheeshana, सीताम् Sita, विनीतवत् reverently, रामस्य to Rama, उपानयत्conducted

40019234.author: Translation
40019234.content: Rama having spoken clearly in that way, Vibheeshana reverently conducted Sita to Rama.

40019235.author: पदार्थः
40019235.content: ततः thereupon, लक्ष्मणसुग्रीवौ Lakshmana and Sugriva, प्लवङ्गमः monkey, हनूमांश्च Hanuman too, रामस्य Rama's, वाक्यम् statement, निशम्य astonished, भृशम् highly, व्यथिताःdistressed, बभूवुः became

40019235.author: Translation
40019235.content: There upon Lakshmana, Sugriva, and Vanara Hanuman, astonished at Rama's statement, became highly distressed.

40019236.author: पदार्थः
40019236.content: कलत्रनिरपेक्ष्षैः no regard towards wife, अस्य his, दारुणैः harsh, इङ्गितैः gestures, राघवम् Raghava, सीतायाम् at Sita, अप्रीतम् displeased, तर्कयन्तिस्म discussed

40019236.author: Translation
40019236.content: Seeing Rama having no regard towards Sita, and his harsh gestures, Lakshmana and Sugriva discussed if Rama was displeased with Sita?

40019237.author: पदार्थः
40019237.content: सा he, मैथिलीतु Mythili also, लज्जया modesty, स्वेषु her own, गात्रेषु throat, अवलीयन्ती limbs shrinking, विभीषणेन by Vibheeshana, अनुगता followed by, भर्तारम् husband, अभ्यवर्तत approached

40019237.author: Translation
40019237.content: Mythili, also adopting modesty, shrinking into her own limbs, approached her husband followed by Vibheeshana.

40019238.author: पदार्थः
40019238.content: सौम्यतरानना gentle lady, पतिदेवता husband alone as god, विस्मयाश्च wondered, प्रहर्षाच्च joyful, स्नेहाच्च affectionately, भर्तुः husband, सौम्यम् gentle, मुकम् face, समुदैक्षत agreeable

40019238.author: Translation
40019238.content: Sita, a gentle lady, who considered her husband as God only wondered with a mixed feeling of joy and affection and looked at the gentle face of Rama.
